Description: Change BUXGiver to Silver Sable from Midtown Vendors. NOTE: this marker slot is the single physical 'special event vendor' spot in the hub - PatchDataMod_Vendors_AnniversaryVendor.json (active) patches this exact same marker to a different NPC for its own event. Only one of these vendor patches should ever be active (in Patches/, not Off/) at a time - the native SpecialEventVendor.prototype only has one Inventories[] slot, so there's no way for two seasonal vendor events to coexist here even if both patches were enabled simultaneously (last one loaded would silently win)
Set Vendor Type to Special Event Vendor

Add Summer Event to Special Events Vendor. Shares this single Inventories[0] slot with PatchDataMod_Vendors_AnniversaryVendor.json (active, SpecialEventVendor.prototype only has one inventory slot natively) - mutually exclusive by design, only activate one seasonal vendor patch at a time
